message.content:
The tests now pass.

The cause was a typo in the unit table in `duration.go`: the `'m'` (minute) unit was mapped to `time.Second`. So "45m" parsed as 45 seconds, and "1h30m" parsed as 1 hour 30 seconds. I changed it to `time.Minute`, and the full suite passes.
